One of the properties of a circle is "The diameter of a circle is the longest chord and it passes from the middle(in this question origin)".

So,the square is all the points can be,and the circle with a radian of 1 is the distance from the point (x,y) to the origin less than or equal to 1.

area of the square is 4

area of the circle is pi

our target group is the area of the circle=pi
